text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day before the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Tomorrow is finally the day, isn't it? The Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Naturally, I'm feeling a bit nervous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my—
Even you get nervous now, Ikuno-san?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, no matter how much I run,
this is the one thing I never get used to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps that serves as proof
that Ikuno-san always pours her whole heart and soul
into every race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...I really wanted to compete against Teio-san
at the 'Arima Kinen'."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It is true that, in some corner of my heart, I feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"However...
Ikuno is in the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have an irreplaceable rival who competed with me in the Tenno Sho (Spring)... and across the Senior Spring Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Please, run for my sake as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Precisely because you have stood upon the turf for so long, I can entrust you with my feelings, my running—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I believe that this is the one-and-only radiance of an Umamusume named Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ......I have received it, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I will run in the Arima Kinen,
for your sake as well without fail.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"However—
Please promise me just this one thing."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That you too will definitely return to the turf.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“And that you will definitely run
with Teio-san and me once more.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, of course.
After all, I am—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I haven't given up, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Impressive as always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, this year's Arima Kinen is packed with talent!
Biwa Hayahide, Winning Ticket, and Tokai Teio making a long-awaited return!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Teio's really going to be okay.
This race entry feels pretty sudden, though...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, you can't help but hope for it...!
Teio's comeback!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ I knew it, everyone really
was waiting for Teio...!
—Oh, if it isn't Turbo-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good day.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: McQueen came to watch too! Good day to you!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, everyone's talking about Teio!
They're so hyped up, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. It is truly full of the passion fitting for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Who did you come to cheer for, McQueen? Ikuno? Or Teio?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
That is a secret.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I can feel the heat of the grandstands
all the way over here.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Arima Kinen.
...My heart is racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This year's Arima Kinen has brought together another magnificent lineup of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Ikuno Dictus running as one of them,
I can't suppress my excitement...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus's long-traveled path.
Praying that this will become another glorious race
etched into her journey—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to it as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Our Arima Kinen, today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(The cheers echo across the track...
A crowd waiting for the Arima Kinen fanfare—)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—It's finally starting to feel a little real,
maybe.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I heard she managed to return to racing.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Teio-san—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(This overwhelming presence——
I can hardly believe she just made her comeback...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...So you have put in that much effort.
You really are—)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll win.
I absolutely will.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"And I'll show everyone!
Tokai Teio is back!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I won't yield victory, of all things.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I shall engrave it upon all of you today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "The revived Tokai Teio, and the one who triumphed over her was Ikuno Dictus," it said.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haha...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I really love that kind of attitude from you, Ikuno!
I'm getting totally fired up now...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright then—
Let's settle this, Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's a match.
—Tokai Teio.
